chapter: Reel 2: race, storm and Bolden vs Robichaux
title: White patrons and police at Lincoln Park
summary: He saw no white people at Lincoln Park; police there were white.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: How about when you go to the Grove Hall, would you see some white people there or it's only colored? I don't know. I don't see any colored out there. I see. How about Lincoln Park over here? I don't see any white people. No? No.
Did they have a policeman there or? Oh yeah, we used to have police. Did they have white policemen there? Oh yeah, white policemen. Only white policemen. Here? Yeah. Go ahead, go ahead.
